# OpenGameArt Assets

This folder contains third-party prototype art used by local Infernux demos.

## Sources

- `pacman-tiles/`: "Pacman Tiles" by misskitt, OpenGameArt, CC0.
  Source: https://opengameart.org/content/pacman-tiles
## Usage Notes

The engine demo uses these as CC0 prototype art for an original pellet maze
sample named `Pellet Chase`. It must not be presented as an official Pac-Man
asset pack or as an official Pac-Man game.
